text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started -> version r2026-03-21-rc7 to model-serving v3.2.4 (5% EU). Details: https://deploy/redwood/rollouts/6888888000. Metrics: latency p95 +12% vs baseline; error rate +0.8%; embeddings reject 0.6%. Change window 03/21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Auto-advance policy 5->20 on green. Please acknowledge with stop/go.

sam: Looking at traces now, I see KV cache thrash on shard eu5-03, lots of cold misses. Tail logs show repeated evictions.

maya: Frontend telemetry: p50 stable but p95 spike concentrated in eu-west-1. Also embedding eval on canary shows 2% drift on rerank test set vs stable.

oncall-bot: Alert: eu5-embed-service high 502s (3 hosts). Pager sent to @ops_karen.

ops_karen: On it, pulling logs + heapdumps. Will check if it's infra or model runtime.

ethan: I'm leaning STOP. If we continue to 20% we risk a larger quality regression. Can we route EU to fallback model while we triage?

lina: Agree stop. Recommend pinning traffic back to r2026-03-20-stable for EU and hold progression. Command to pin: `/deploy pin --version=r2026-03-20-stable --scope=eu --percent=5 --reason="canary embed drift"`

jordan: Rollback path ready (no schema changes). Ops, do you prefer full rollback or traffic pin & warmcut? Need to minimize cache penalties.

sam: The KV cache misses look like a mismatch in kvcache format after a quantization tweak in rc7. Reverting profile should fix without full rollback.

ops_karen: I can perform a pin->warmcut: pin to stable then shift a small fraction back if steady. ETA 4m to run pin and confirm health.

maya: Vote: :stop: (hold progression)

ethan: Vote: :stop:

lina: Vote: :stop:

deploy-bot: Stop votes recorded. Automated progression paused. Manual action required to pin or rollback. Suggested next steps: ops_karen to pin; eng-runtime to prepare rollback artifact; post updates to #incidents if we escalate.

ops_karen: Executing pin now: `/deploy pin --version=r2026-03-20-stable --scope=eu --percent=5 --force` (started).

deploy-bot: Pin command acknowledged. Pausing canary progression. Traffic for EU 5% reverted to r2026-03-20-stable. Monitoring for 15m.

sam: I'll run the canary eval suite against the rc7 logs and KV trace to confirm root cause, posting results in ~15m.

maya: Please add to release notes: reverted quantization profile that caused embed drift; follow-up: validate quantization on rerank/eval harness before next cut.

ops_karen: Pin completed at 6888888030. Systems returning to baseline for EU region.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused and pinned. Next check-in at +15m or on any regression.
